observations.baseline: Fresh local TEST runtime with the server-owned initial state.
observations.action: Navigate to the Game Hub slot and inspect the rendered page.
observations.expected: The map, player, objective, controls, journal, release lineage, and authority limits are visible without clipping.

observations.claim: visible controls and keyboard share one bounded action gate
observations.baseline: Player at the live saved revision.
observations.action: Click a visible interaction control, move with a visible direction control, move with ArrowLeft, open Help, and close it with Escape.
observations.expected: Every action advances only through the revision-checked server API and the overlay remains escapable.
observations.observed: Luma interaction completed, pointer and ArrowLeft moves advanced the same server state, and Escape closed Help.

observations.baseline: No completed roots in a fresh bounded save.

observations.observed: The visible-control journey completed in 192 moves with four roots, ten inventory discoveries, six quests, and the authored A Door Into Review ending.

observations.claim: browser reload preserves exact server-owned progress
observations.expected: The browser re-fetches the same server revision rather than inventing or losing progress.
observations.observed: All four roots, ten discoveries, six quests, 192 moves, and the ending remained visible.

observations.claim: real server restart restores the exact content-bound save
observations.baseline: Completed state persisted by the local server outside the repository.

observations.expected: The new process accepts only the save bound to the exact content digest and restores it.
observations.observed: The fresh process restored the 192-move completed state and A Door Into Review ending.

observations.claim: narrow layout remains readable and operable
observations.baseline: Completed state in a clean temporary Chrome window.

observations.expected: The layout stacks without horizontal clipping and preserves the full game state and controls.
